keġebe: keġe- — to say; past -be, 'said' (verb, past tense) [說了]
tedüi: tedüi — so much, so, thus (adverb) [那般] · also 'so, then, thereupon' (a sentence adverb; Ming 便 'at once') · also 'so much, like, as' after a genitive, the size comparison (Ming 般) · also a pronoun, 'those, so many' (Ming 那些 'those')
nača: -(n)ača — ablative: from (back-vowel form; the token left after Burqan-Qaldun-(n)-, 'from Burqan Qaldun') [山名 自] · also after Qaγan-(n)-, 'from the Qaγan' (ablative; the (n) is Shiratori's; the Ming 皇帝 行 writes 行, not 處) · also after Waṅ-Qān-(n)-, 'from Wang Qan' (Ming 處 'at the place of') · also after Qān-(n)- 'from the Qan' and Gür-Qān-(n)- 'from Gür-Qan' (ablative; Ming 處) [人名皇帝 處]
tende: tende — there, then (from tere 'that'; locative adverb) [那裏]
ažuγ̇u: a- — to be; past ažuγ̇u, 'there was, he was' [有來]
odqu: od- — to go; participle -qu, 'the one going' (verb, participle) [去的]
jača: -(j)ača — ablative: from, of (back-vowel form; the token left after noγai-(j)ača and boluqui-(j)ača, where the (j) is Shiratori's) (case suffix) [狗 行]
irežü: ire- — to come; converb -žü, 'coming' (verb, converb) [來着]
na: -(n)a — dative-locative: at, in, to (back-vowel form) [行] · also a particle na (Ming 好生 'well, very'; sense uncertain), in bolγaqu na žöb, 'to be made, na, right' (§126) · also Waṅ-Qān-(n)a, 'to Wang Qan' (after a stem ending in n; the (n) is Shiratori's; Ming 人名行)
ügülebe: ügüle- — to speak, say; past -be, 'spoke' (verb, past tense) [說了]
